track: 02 · The Agent That Can Explain Why

build.role: Memory with provenance: every piece of evidence and every answer is stored with its source, and a trust ledger records each read and write
build.evidence: H-MEM conformance suite run against our implementation

power.role: Primary AI provider: every agent call goes to Meterless Runtime (Nightshift) over its OpenAI-compatible API, with NVIDIA direct as a fallback only when the runtime is unreachable
power.evidence: npm run sponsors (runtime health), test/meterless.test.ts, test/client.test.ts

nvidia.role: Nemotron models behind every agent: nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b for bulk reading, nemotron-3-ultra-550b for reasoning and answers
nvidia.evidence: npm run smoke checks cited evidence verbatim against the code; npm run usage shows calls and tokens per model

zetaris.role: Data layer: GitHub history (commits, pull requests, issues) and the code map, queried with Lightning SQL to build each evidence chain
zetaris.evidence: npm run sponsors runs SELECT 1 and SHOW LIGHTNING DATABASES over the REST API

cursor.evidence: Cursor sessions during the build window

runWithoutKeys: npm install && npm test (every integration is tested against mocks)
